legend: You are given $N$ integers. Count how many of them are even, how many are odd, how many are positive and how many are negative.
input: The first line contains $N$ ($1 \le N \le 10^3$). The second line contains $N$ integers $X_i$ ($-10^5 \le X_i \le 10^5$).
output:
Print four lines:
\begin{itemize}
\item "Even: $E$"
\item "Odd: $O$"
\item "Positive: $P$"
\item "Negative: $Q$"
\end{itemize}
where $E$, $O$, $P$, $Q$ are the four counts.
notes: Zero is even, but it is neither positive nor negative.
